subject: help creating a cpu heatmap graph with ggplot2

messages.author: f29d62ed7c6ee7e6
messages.subject: help creating a cpu heatmap graph with ggplot2
parts:
I am trying to create a heatmap for 15minute cpu utilization. I need to have the colors break by this:
 
breaks = c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100)
colours=c("#F0FFFF","#AEEEEE","#ADD8E6","#87CEFA","#00FF00","#E4F224","#C9821E", "#FF0000", "#FF0000")
 
I tried using this but I am not seeing the right colors assigning to the cell. It is either one off or I sometimes see dark gray color when I start to change the values.
 
scale_fill_gradientn(name="CPU Utilization", colours=c("#F0FFFF","#AEEEEE","#ADD8E6","#87CEFA","#00FF00","#E4F224","#C9821E", "#FF0000", "#FF0000"),
values=c(0.19,0.29,0.39,0.49,0.59,0.69, 0.79,0.89,0.99,1), limits=c(0,100),
breaks = c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100))
 
Any ideas, how can do this better?
 
Here is the whole command I tried:
 
ggplot(x, aes(DATE, Time, fill=CPU)) + geom_tile() + theme_bw() + scale_x_date(breaks = "2 weeks", labels=date_format("%b %d, %Y")) + scale_y_datetime(breaks="2 hours", labels=date_format("%H:%M"))  + scale_colour_discrete(name="15 Minute CPU") + scale_fill_gradientn(name="CPU Utilization", colours=c("#F0FFFF","#AEEEEE","#ADD8E6","#87CEFA","#00FF00","#E4F224","#C9821E", "#FF0000", "#FF0000"), values=c(0,0.19,0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7, 0.8,0.9,1), limits=c(0,100), breaks = c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100)) + guides(fill = guide_legend(keywidth = 3, keyheight = 1)) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold", angle=45, hjust=1), axis.text.y=element_text(size=10, face="bold"), axis.title.x=element_text(colour="brown", face="bold", size=12), axis.title.y=element_text(colour="brown", face="bold", size=12), plot.title=element_text(size=15, colour="black", face="bold"))
